eps.d: Santa Barbara, July 30th, 1979. In the Capwell residence, a reception is being held in honour of Channing Jr, one of the off-spring of powerful C.C.. Accepting a note inviting him to go to the office, Channing Jr leaves the guests and enters the room when somebody fires at him. Five years later, Joe Perkins is released from prison for good behaviour.

At the railway station, Joe is welcomed by his mother and sister who bring him back home. Santana, surprised by Rosa, her mother, drops her revolver on the floor. Mason, who is surprised by this gesture, tries to find out why she would want to attempt to kill the supposed murderer of her stepbrother.

Mason hopes that witnesses saw Santana with her weapon the day before, in the coach station. But it seems very quickly that it is only an excuse to get closer to her, when he makes her believe that he succeeded in removing the charges against her in one phone call. Rosa, who is very angry with C.C., cannot help revealing to him that she knows everything about Santana's baby.

It does not take Kelly a long time to notice Joe on the harbour. Peter makes her go back inside the yacht, while she begins panicking. C.C., accompanied with his henchmen, gets them to throw Joe into the water, not without threatening him. Santana surprises Mason, by staying in his flat, he watches her undressing in his bathroom.

John, who discovers damage caused at home by the bomb, is taken to see Joe whom he considers to be representative. Joe prefers moving away in an instant from this different family to find for the second time his mysterious ally, who says he is called Dominic. Thanks to him, Joe begins remembering the presence of a guest the evening of the murder which would have been witness of the act.

Joe tries to make Kelly listen to him telling her that he is innocent of her brother's murder and that he has always loved her. But Kelly refuses to listen to him, when Peter arrives; he has guessed that something was wrong. In spite of the threat with his gun, Peter is pushed by Joe, who succeeds in running away after the shouting from Kelly.

Joe, at home accepts the visit from two policemen, sent by Mason, who have come to question him about the break-ins having taken place in neighbourhood the night before. And yet being with Dominic in the warehouse, Joe can give no valid alibi. Again, Marisa encourages her son to forget Kelly and to avoid problems so as the Capwells could talk to him.

CC throws a party to celebrate Mason's career, but accidentally calls him Channing, leading to a confrontation. Santana tricks the doctor into telling her CC has known where her baby is all along. Peter is angry about having to stay in bed after the accident and missing CC's party. Dominic surprises Joe with a gun and tells him to break into the Capwell mansion and search Channing's room.

Jade joins Ted and Danny in LA. Dominic gets Joe a plan of the Capwell mansion so he can break into Channing's room. Kelly burns the love letters Joe gave her. Peter is insecure about his relationship with Kelly. Santana confronts CC about her son, but he refuses to tell her anything.

Augusta flirts with Joe. Santana hires a private detective to follow CC, but he tells CC about it. Kelly is angry when she finds out Mason has been keeping newspaper clippings from Joe's murder trial. The fire on the Capwell oil rig worsens. Joe's father warns him to stay away from Kelly, but instead he breaks into the Capwell mansion.

Joe tries to break into Channing's bedroom, but has to escape when the security alarms go off. Warren tells Laken he thinks Augusta is having an affair with Joe. There's a fire on the Capwell oil rig, and we are introduced to Cruz Castillo, who works there.

Joe and Kelly both receive notes telling them to be at the same address the following morning. Kelly thinks Peter is too worried about her. Augusta makes sure Joe loses the job he was promised. CC visits Cruz in hospital and offers him a job.

Joe tries to talk to Kelly at the set up rendez-vous, but she won't listen. Santana tries to convince Rosa to search for a photo of her son in the Capwell mansion. Laken visits Ted in LA. Joe tells Augusta he'll accept her job offer. Mason warns Peter not to flirt with other women, after seeing him flirt with Santana.
Peter warns Augusta to fire Joe. Dominic gives Joe the code to the Capwell mansion alarm system.

Augusta tells Peter she'll get rid of Joe for $100,000, and threatens to tell everyone about their past fling if he crosses her. CC tells Cruz to stay away from Joe, but Cruz refuses to believe Joe murdered Channing. Augusta continues to try and seduce Joe, and they kiss. Joe breaks into the Capwell mansion while the family is at a yacht party.
Joe gets Cruz to hide him in his room while the police search the Capwell house. Santana questions Rosa about CC.
Kelly helps Joe escape from the mansion. Santana gives CC a gift for her son.

Augusta threatens to tell Kelly about her affair with Peter. He threatens to say she's having an affair with Joe. Joe gives Dominic the papers he found in Channing's room. Santana finds Cruz a new place to live. Kelly sees Joe and Augusta looking intimate. Joe kisses Kelly.
Kelly is confused after kissing Joe, and decides to sleep with Peter. Mason thinks Joe attacked Kelly and tries to arrest him.

Santana finds a house for Kelly and Peter. Minx confronts Augusta about having sex with Joe in the house. Peter rubs it in Joe's face that Kelly is his. Joe vows to ensure Peter and Kelly never marry.
Joe and Dominic find a love letter to Santana amongst channing's papers. Joe confronts Santana with it. Laken tells Ted about her mother's affair with Joe.

Peter and Kelly set a wedding date, but CC asks them to postpone it to mid-November. Cruz arranges for Joe to speak to Santana about Channing's love letter, and she's furious. Peter threatens Augusta about Joe again.
Santana is missing. Lionel returns to town.
CC rescues Santana, and she kisses him. Jade gets into trouble.
Joe questions Santana about Channing while she's in hospital. Augusta cooks Laken's carrier pigeon. Joe hides in Dominic's car.
Laken goes to stay at the Capwell's. Joe follows Dominic to channing's grave and realises he is the witness from channing's murder.

Augusta and Lionel try to get Laken to come home. Mason gets Peter to question Augusta about where her property papers are kept. Ted fights for his relationship with Laken. Joe confronts Dominic about being there at Channing's murder.
Joe confronts Dominic with a gun and gets him to admit he was the witness from Channing's murder. Ted and Laken go off together, despite their parents' protests.

Kelly is excited at the prospect of Joe's innocence. Mason searches the Lockridge house, pretending that Joe was involved in a robbery and has hidden jewels there. Someone hits Joe over the head and helps Dominic escape. When he regained consciousness, Mason believes he made everything up.

Lionel confronts Augusta about her affair with Joe. Jade goes for a screentest but it turns out to be a porno film. Cruz makes a move on Santana, but she rebuffs him. Santana continues to try to get close to CC. Peter asks the Capwell hotel manager to install a two-way mirror in the presidential suite, after Mason wants to use it for a rendezvous-vous.

Joe asks Cruz to invite Kelly over so he can see her. Peter tells Augusta that Mason was looking for the deeds to her beachfront property. And she's rattled when Peter tells her Joe found his witness.

Peter challenges Joe to a fight, winner gets Kelly. Joe refuses but Peter hits him anyway. Joe knocks him out and later Peter tells Kelly Joe started it. Cruz starts to confront Santana about copying Sophia to impress CC. Joe begs Kelly to keep the ring he bought for her five years ago. They kiss.
Ted and Danny return from LA. Peter tells Mason he's afraid Kelly is going to leave him. Joe sends Kelly flowers and the ring back.

Ted and Laken tell their parents they want to move in together. Peter tells Kelly she has to choose between him and Joe. Santana tells Cruz about a gazebo where she and Channing used to meet. He thinks their love letters may be hidden there.

Kelly runs away. Dominic steals Santana's letters from Channing, which detail a hidden panel in the gazebo. She accuses Cruz of stealing them. Peter plans to use the two-way mirror in the hotel to spy on mason. Peters secretary tells Lionel about it and he decides to use it as well.

Joe and Dominic take the box from the gazebo. Lionel spies on Augusta and Peter talking in the presidential suite, then on the bankers and mason when they arrive to discuss the Lockridge beachfront property. Joe reads the letters and finds out about Santana and Channing's baby. Cruz kisses Santana.

Channing's diary reveals that he'd found out a secret which put him in danger. Cruz finds out about Santana's baby. Joe finds a postcard from Channing addressed to "LL with love". Peter begs Ted to call Kelly.
Kelly returns and tells Peter she believes Joe is innocent. Mason and the Lockridge bid on the beachfront property.

Lionel tries to blackmail Mason but Mason refuses and gets the beachfront property. After Joe and Dominic find things from a motel amongst Channing's things, Dominic goes there and rips out a page from 1960.

Joe confronts Dominic about taking the page from the motel register. Joe finds an article about Sophia Capwell being kidnapped and held captive at the same motel 24 years before. Kelly goes to see Joe. Santana tells Cruz that she's falling in love with CC.
Kelly meets up with joe. Santana meets Brandon in the hotel without knowing who he is.

Kelly meets Dominic. CC and Santana make love. A strange woman, Ginger, captures Peter, and it's revealed that he used to work for her as a prostitute called Antonio. Warren confronts Lionel about the rumours that he and Sophia Capwell had an affair. Ginger blackmails Peter. Dominic is a woman!

Kelly wants to help Joe and Dominic find Channing's killer. Santana tells CC that Joe and Cruz know about the baby and that they're working together to prove Joe's innocence. CC is worried that joe might try to hurt Channing's son. Peter and CC want to rush the wedding. Joe searches Dominic's apartment. Ginger is Kelly's dressmaker.

CC invites Santana to his birthday party so they can be a couple in the open. Joe asks Dominic to look into the connection between Sophia and Lionel. CC visits Gina and Brandon after Gina's husband died, and asks her to go on vacation. Augusta is worried that Channing's real killer might be found. She thinks the person who robbed the Capwell house might be a suspect.

Peter begs mason for a loan to pay off ginger, and mason says he'll help him if Peter gets Joe back in prison. Eden is on her way home. Santana is furious that Cruz went to Acapulco to find out about her baby. Mason is shocked when Santana arrives to CC's party as his date.

A patient at the mental hospital tells Joe that Dominic is a woman who used to be a patient there. CC's party continues as Eden parachutes in as a surprise. Eden and Cruz pretend to meet for the first time. CC promises Mason a promotion as thanks for getting the beachfront property. But then CC opens the gift Lionel sent with the recording of Mason insulting CC.

Veronica lies at Lionel's request, and says it isn't her or Mason on the tape. Peter plants drugs on Joe's motorcycle, and tips off the police. Jade borrows the bike and gets arrested. Dominic finds out Joe was in Anchorage, and Joe confronts him with the fact that he's a woman. Kelly fights with CC and leaves the mansion. Eden invites Cruz over.

Cruz tells CC he knows Gina has Santana's son. Ginger holds Joe and Peter captive. Peter manages to get the gun and threatens to kill Ginger. Lionel sees Santana has the bracelet he once gave Sophia. Eden asks Cruz to meet her at Sophia's grave. She tells Cruz to leave town, as they promised never to see each other again. Eden sees Lionel at the grave.

Augusta finds evidence that Warren set fire to the pawn shop, and Ted finds a newspaper cutting from the Capwell robbery that happened just before Channing's murder in the Lockridge fireplace. Joe and Kelly kiss and make plans to be together. A drunk Lionel thinks Eden is Sophia returned from the dead. The police hunt for Joe with an arrest warrant.

Warren admits to Augusta that he was stealing from Channing. The police continue their manhunt for Joe. Lionel watches Eden and leaves a love poem and a hair ribbon for her. Police find Joe's shirt and shoe and think he's been attacked by a shark. Cruz secretly tries to get some secret service friends to find Joe. Ginger turns up at Peter's again, demanding the blackmail money again.

Santana's father disapproves of her seeing CC. Eden realises it's Lionel who has been following her. She leaves him a note telling him to stop, and he replies asking her to meet him at Sophia's grave. Cruz continues to search for Joe. Ted asks Mason if the Lockridges were ever suspects in the Capwell robbery.
Brandon goes missing and Peter finds him in the secret room with the two-way mirror. Kelly tells warren she's going to continue the investigation into Channing's murder. Joe is alive in a boat.

Peter suspects something is going on with regards to Brandon being adopted and CC's involvement. Ginger continues to take payments from Peter. Santana is jealous of CC's close relationship with Gina. Peter asks for money from Mason in return for his information about CC and Brandon, but Mason turns him down. Santana finds out that Brandon is adopted.

Minx meets with a stranger called Brick Wallace, whom she has collected information on, and asks him to be her chauffeur. Joe escapes from the couple who rescued him. Lionel sends Eden another gift. Summer sees the coins Warren stole from the Capwells, and he begs her never to say anything. Santana tells Rosa she suspects Brandon is her son. Peter tells Mason about CC arranging Brandon's adoption.
Santana goes to see Brandon in LA. Eden knows Cruz is doing a job undercover in Santa Barbara. Augusta tells Lionel she thinks Warren killed Channing. Minx hires Brick as her chauffeur.
CC stops Santana from seeing Brandon. Eden tries to get Cruz to help her by threatening to expose him as a spy. Joe finds Kelly and they make love.

Amy arrives home for Joe's memorial. Kelly manages to tell Jade that Joe is alive. CC tries to get Santana to sign an agreement that she'll never see Brandon. Augusta is very curious about the new chauffeur, Brick. Santana chooses Brandon over her relationship with CC.

Kelly lets Marisa, Amy and Cruz know that Joe is alive. Kelly tells Ted that warren dropped one of the stolen coins. Eden watches Lionel give a talk at the museum, and later finds a note inviting her back when the museum closes. Warren hunts for his coin, and is panicked when Summer tells him Kelly has it. Kelly and Joe have a romantic evening in secret.

Mason is upset that he can't find his mother, Pamela. Veronica warns Peter that Mason knows he's been taking $10,000 a day from the Capwell account. Brick meets Amy and Jade and helps take a drunk Amy home. Peter discovers Kelly booked the presidential suite. Santana and Mason share their woes.

Peter spies on Kelly in the hotel suite, but can't see who she's with. Eden tells Lionel to stop his obsession with her, and he calls her Sophia. Later, Eden asks Mason to tell her about Sophia. Ted tells Laken he loves her. Warren questions Ted about Channing's murder and Kelly's investigation of it.

Kelly breaks up with Peter. Amy comes by to thank Brick for rescuing her. CC and Lionel have words over the beach property and their feud. Mason confronts Peter about Ginger, but Peter refuses to admit she's the one he's been paying off. Lionel announces his intention to raise a shipwreck belonging to his ancestors. Dominic finally offers to come forward as Joe's alibi.

Dominic is scared off when Kelly tells him she knows he's a woman. Mason warns Peter he'll be arrested if he doesn't pay back the money. Mason tracks down where CC has hidden Gina. Amy goes for an interview with Minx. Warren tries to get the coin back from Kelly. Mason goes to Peter's apartment and sees Ginger and her goons break in.
Kelly gives Warren the wrong coin back via Summer. Ginger proposes to kidnap Kelly if Peter gets her over to his apartment. Lionel continues to send gifts to Eden.
Kelly is kidnapped. Mason realizes Ginger was involved. Santana is in France, watching Gina and the child.

Cruz and Mason suspect Peter is involved in Kelly's kidnapping. Ginger demands Peter be the one to deliver the million dollar ransom. Santana bonds with Brandon. Minx is making Brick do all sorts of tests, which he hopes will result in her explaining why she brought him to Santa Barbara. Joe tells Dominic he's alive and asks him to help find Kelly. Ginger plans on killing both Kelly and Peter.

Dominic and Joe discover where Ginger lives, and tip off the Capwells. Peter warns Ginger about it. Santana continues to get closer to Gina and Brandon. Joe gets Amy a job temping for Peter so she can spy on him.

The police question Ginger but find nothing. Dominic and Joe in disguise threaten Peter for info. Peter arrives with the ransom money at a deserted warehouse. The Capwells have Peter followed in a helicopter. Peter suggests Ginger make a run for it and he'll pretend to be the hero who saved Kelly.

Warren tells Summer that he set the fire at the pawnshop to destroy evidence. Peter "rescues" Kelly while Ginger and her goons escape. Joe tries to see Kelly in the hospital. Peter recognised him under the disguise.

Kelly refuses to go home to the Capwell mansion because Joe will be waiting for her at her apartment. Peter realises it was Joe Kelly was with at the presidential suite. Eden and Cruz talk about when they first met three years before. Santana continues to fall in love with Brandon and vows she'll never let him go. Joe tells Kelly about Peter's past as a prostitute.

Lionel continues to stalk Eden. Dominic and Joe figure out that Lionel and Sophia had an affair, and that Warren was trying to hide it because everything he stole belonged to Sophia. Peter plans to kill Joe and asks Ginger to get him a gun. Mason still can't find his mother. Peter blackmails Mason for a promotion. CC finds out that Santana is in Nice with Brandon and Gina.

An earthquake is coming. Mason goes to France to see Santana. Peter gets Kelly to say he can help her find Channing's killer. He fakes a note from Dominic asking Joe to meet him, and follows him to Dominic's apartment. Dominic sends a note to Lionel to meet him at Sophia's grave.
Sophia's ghost haunts Lionel. Eden and Augusta spar a the museum. Cruz warns CC about the coming earthquake. Gina and Brandon leave to return to Santa Barbara, so Santana and mason leave too.
Eden asks Lionel if he and Sophia were lovers, but he won't answer. Peter lures Joe to a nature reserve so he can kill him. Augusta is furious after Eden told her Lionel was having an affair.

Peter tries to shoot Joe but misses. Augusta thinks Lionel is having an affair and that Sophia's swimsuit belongs to his mistress. Brick tries to get Minx to tell him why he's there. Santana babysits Brandon while Gina is in LA, much to CC's anger. Ted and Laken plan to spend the night on the Capwell yacht. Kelly confronts Warren about stealing the coins, and accuses him of killing Channing.

Joe is arrested for shooting Peter. The earthquake is coming. Lionel arranges to meet Eden, planning to tell her about him and Sophia, but Augusta follows him and interrupts them. Ted tries to get the coin back from Warren. CC tries to get Brandon away from Santana.

When the earthquake hits, Mason has to save Brandon's life. Augusta falls down a cliff and Lionel goes to save her. Ted is trapped in a cave and warren tries to dig him out. The Capwell house sustains major damage.

In the aftermath of the earthquake, Lionel and Augusta are trapped in a cave. Kelly and Dominic are also trapped in a basement, and Dominic refuses to let Kelly see her real face. Warren rescues Ted. John Perkins dies. Santana tells her father about Brandon.

Lionel finally admits to Augusta that he had an affair with Sophia and that he was with her on the night she fell overboard. Joe is trapped with Kelly and Dominic. Santana and Brandon pass out because of a gas leak, and Mason rescues them. Eden threatens to blow Cruz's cover if he doesn't use his connections to help find Kelly. Kelly and Joe get married unofficially where they're trapped.

Mason proposes to Santana. Kelly and Joe are rescued, as are Lionel and Augusta. Marisa tells her family John is dead. Ruben is in critical condition in the hospital. Dominic /Sophia escapes from the basement before anyone sees her. Kelly begs Mason to drop the drug charges against Joe before she goes into surgery.

Warren retrieved the coins he hid in the cave. Kelly's surgery is a success. Peter tells Mason and Joe that he will only tell Kelly the truth about Channing. Lionel confronts Eden about the swimsuit and trying to drive him mad, but she denies it. Sophia goes to the hospital in a veil. Mason asks Santana again to marry him, but she is hesitant.
Sophia begs Peter to tell her who killed Channing, and nearly kills him. CC asks Gina to move into the mansion permanently. Mason and Santana grow closer. Dominic brings Kelly in to see Peter.

Lionel follows Dominic home. Peter reveals to Kelly that Channing had found out about his affair with Augusta and his past with Ginger and threatened to expose him. Then on the day of the murder he saw Channing already dead, and Joe and Dominic come running in.

Peter says he saw mason in the room where Channing was murdered. He then goes into cardiac arrest, but recovers. Dominic / Sophia leaves the apartment so Lionel can't find her. Kelly tried to talk to mason about what Peter said, but he avoids her.

Peter refuses to take back what he said about seeing Mason in the murder room. Kelly threatens to tell everyone if Mason doesn't explain. Cruz and Eden bond over a young boy whose parents were missing in the earthquake.

Augusta is worried that the murder investigation will incriminate Warren. Peter refuses to take back his statement about seeing Mason in the murder room. Dominic meets Lionel at Sophia's grave, and accuses him of murdering both Sophia and Channing. Kelly tries to tell the DA that Mason killed Channing, but Mason stops her.

Joe is exonerated by the court. Joe and Kelly talk about their wedding plans, and CC pretends to be supportive, but privately tells Mason he won't let Kelly marry Joe. Amy is devastated to find out she's pregnant. Minx tells Brick he can leave if he wants, and after he thinks Amy doesn't want to see him anymore, he decides to go back to Vegas. But Amy talks him into staying for a little longer.

Peter falls into a coma after his IV comes out and mason refuses to put it back in. Kelly thinks mason tried to murder Peter. Brick and Amy grow closer but she doesn't tell him she's pregnant by her ex boyfriend. Laken is upset when no one will tell her why warren and ted are fighting.

CC finds out that mason was apparently in the room with Channing's body. Assuming mason killed Channing, he cuts him out of the will. Jade finds out Amy is pregnant. Ted apologises to Warren for thinking he was involved in Channing's murder. Mason tells Santana what Peter said, and she believes Mason's side.

Eden asks Cruz to spy on Lionel. CC threatens Mason with a gun and refuses to believe he didn't kill Channing. Peter slips into a coma. Santana is upset that CC is starting to control Brandon's life. Mason finds out that CC is leaving a quarter of his money to Brandon, and investigates. He finds out that Santana is Brandon's mother.

Amy tells Brick she's pregnant. She goes to San Francisco to tell the father, and Brick surprises her by accompanying her. Mason tells Santana he knows about Brandon, but she keeps the fact that Channing was the father from him. Eden is incensed when Lionel shows her a videotape he has of pictures and interviews of Sophia. Dominic makes Lionel give him the video tape at gunpoint.

Mason tells Santana he knows Channing was the father, and becomes angry and violent towards her. Eden asks Cruz to teach her to dive so she can get in on the dive to the sunken Lockridge ship. Amy doesn't tell her ex that she's pregnant. Mason tells Santana to marry him, and threatens to tell Gina and Brandon about her if she doesn't.

Santana decides to leave town, hoping that will stop Mason from telling Gina the truth. Mason tries to tell Gina, but realises he can't ruin Brandon's life. Summer is upset about something from her past.

Mason has Peter moved from the hospital, on hearing that Peter is regaining consciousness. Lionel catches Eden diving down to the Amanda Lockridge. Amy's ex refuses to believe her baby is his. Augusta tries to find out who Minx has hired to run the family stock portfolio, but Brick feigns ignorance.
Ted and Laken plan to spend the night together on the yacht. Lionel continues to be creepy and make advances on Eden, and inexplicably she keeps responding and then pulling away.

Ted and Laken see Eden and Lionel together on the yacht. Augusta surprises Eden and Lionel, just as Eden slaps him. Mason has Peter hidden away in secret in a clinic. Augusta refuses to believe Lionel that he and Eden aren't having an affair. Sophia (as Dominic) is hidden in their closet as they argue about Eden and how Lionel loved Sophia.

Amy tells her mother she's pregnant. Augusta continues to argue with Lionel while Dominic hides in the closet. Dominic drops the note that says "meet me in the study" from the night of Channing's murder. Augusta sees it, but Dominic manages to get it back. Amy tells Brick she wants to keep the baby. Cruz warns Eden to stay away from Lionel.

Elizabeth Peale arrives to give a lecture at the museum, and falls foul of Lionel. But it transpires they are working together to hide artwork on the Amanda Lockridge wreck, and pretend it was there for 100 years. Sophia is excited to set up Lionel for Channing's murder. Peter regains consciousness, finds out Mason has hidden him in a clinic, and calls Veronica for help. Veronica tells Lionel.

CC and Lionel continue to fight about CC's ancestor sinking the Amanda Lockridge ship. Minx catches Dominic in the house and pulls a gun on him. The Lockridges are afraid after the second break-in in two days, but Lionel guesses it was Dominic. Veronica promises Peter she'll help him, but Lionel advises her to tell Mason. He then goes to see Peter himself.

Lionel makes a deal with Peter to break him out of the clinic if he tells him who killed Channing. Mason catches them in the ambulance. Summer has more flashbacks to when she was raped, and runs away from Warren. Gina and Elizabeth Peale compete for CC's attention. Eden and Ted find out about Mason being in the room with Channing.

Mason returns Peter to the clinic. Lionel and Elizabeth plan the fake treasure discovery on the ship, and they dive down to fetch the safe. Gina and Elizabeth continue to butt heads. Lionel flashes back to the day Channing was murdered, when Channing told him he was going to expose his affair with Sophia, and accuse Lionel of murdering her.

Lionel and Elizabeth open the safe and examine the things inside. Mason tells his family that Peter won't be charged for the attempted murder of Joe. Mason uses this to try convince Peter to take back his statement about Mason being in the study. Mason offers Peter a quarter of his inheritance, and Peter, not knowing Mason has no inheritance, accepts.

Eden watches as Lionel and his men bring up the safe and artwork from the wreck. Peter holds a press conference about what he saw when Channing was murdered. He insists he only saw the shadow of a man in the study with Channing's body before Joe came in. Afterwards, Mason tells Peter that CC disinherited him, meaning Peter won't get the share of the inheritance he promised.

Tv crews and crowds gather as Lionel opens up the paintings and safe from the shop. Meanwhile mason discovers the stolen coins at lionel's House, as well as newspaper clippings about channing's murder, and sends police to arrest Lionel at the museum.

Mason arrests Lionel. Kelly and Joe tell Mason about Sophia's affair with Lionel, and he becomes convinced that Lionel murdered Channing. Sophia phones Mason and tells him to check Lionel's tuxedo, and Mason finds the note she planted there.

Lionel spends Christmas Eve in jail, and promises mason he'll admit to channing's murder if he can see Augusta first. Mason finds the note Dominic planted, and the blood on it is channing's blood type.

Lionel spends Christmas in jail. The police let mason know that they found lionel's fingerprints in the Capwell study. Mason searches the Lockridge house again, while the family is taking Christmas dinner to Lionel.

As lionel's bail hearing looms, Sophia sends mason a video of Lionel and Warren discussing the stolen coins. Mason proceeds to charge Lionel with channing's murder, based on Lionel having the ring in his house which Channing was wearing the day he died.

Sophia is thrilled when Lionel is charged with Channing's murder, leading Kelly and Joe to suspect that she might have set him up. Mason tells CC about lionel's affair with Sophia, and CC refuses to believe it. Eden keeps quiet that she knew about the affair.

CC asks Cruz to sneak into the museum to see what's in the logbook from the shipwreck. Both Cruz and Eden show up to do it. Lionel, Augusta and Warren burn warren's tux before the police can figure out it wasn't lionel's. Amy tells Brick to stay away from her.

Cruz and Eden get trapped in the museum by the guards and have to spend the night there. Warren tells Lionel he found Channing just after he was shot. Eden takes the photos Cruz took of the logbook while he's sleeping.

Augusta and Lionel figure out that the note was planted in Warren's tux when the house was broken into. Sophia decides to "retire" Dominic. Joe takes Kelly to the hospital to find out why she's getting headaches. Cruz tries to get the slides back from Eden, she resists, and he steals them back. When she tries again to get them back he kisses her to distract her.

Eden tries to get CC to fire Cruz. Mason tells Ted about Lionel and Sophia's affair. Eden lies and says she doesn't believe it. Lionel follows Dominic and accosts him; he gets away, but Lionel sees the women's clothes in the suitcase. He follows Dominic onto a train. Mason tries to prove that CC and Sophia had an unhappy marriage, driving her into Lionel's arms.

Lionel hunts for Dominic on the train. Sophia has flashbacks to how afraid she was of Lionel, and the night he tried to kill her. Gina tries to find out more about Sophia from Rosa. Amy has an old friend come visit. CC and Rosa discuss Sophia, and he tells her he suspects the affair was real. Sophia tries to stab Lionel and he finally sees and recognises her.

Peter is released from hospital, despite the doctor's worries about his blackouts. He's immediately obsessed with seeing Kelly. Sophia admits she set Lionel up for Channing's murder because she thinks he tried to kill her. Augusta tells Laken about Lionel's affair with Sophia.

A tramp steals Lionel's clothes and wallet as he lies unconscious near the railway. Marcello begs Sophia to return home with him, but she is reluctant to leave her children. Eden and Cruz strike a deal to hunt for the missing emerald together. Peter imagines that the waitress at La Mesa is Kelly, and he returns and kills her.

Peter wakes up with no memory of murdering the waitress. Lionel is picked up by a travelling circus and manages to get back on the train. Ted and Laken run away together. Peter realises he's the murderer, and destroys the scarf he strangled the waitress with. Eden and Cruz go diving to the wreck, and Eden has an accident.

Cruz revives Eden and they kiss. Lionel holds Sophia on the train again. Mason talks to Summer about the Lockridge case. Cruz and Eden find the desk from the ship. The police are after Lionel on the train. CC offers Joe a job.
Peters doctor tells him he has a life-threatening brain aneurysm. He follows Kelly to a bar, but sees Summer and fixates on her. He tricks her into coming with him, and gives her a carnation.

Warren finds Summer's body, and has to break the news to Gina. Lionel calls to say he's all right. Joe agrees to CC throwing him and Kelly a wedding. Ted and Laken come home. Kelly realises she was the last person to see both of the murdered girls. Mason finds out that Lionel was with Sophia when she died, and jumps to the conclusion that Lionel murdered her as well as Channing.
Lionel is hiding out at Veronica's. Gina thinks Hank, who raped Summer years ago, might be the person who killed her. Sophia arrives back in Santa Barbara, disguised as the Contessa Armonti.

Sophia, dressed as a homeless woman, talks to Ted on the beach to find out what he thinks of her. He tells her his mother was having an affair. Mason and the detective go to LA to look for Hank Judson.

It's Summer's memorial service. Peter sneaks in and hides, confused about what he did. Detective monroe asks Cruz to help him on the carnation killer case. Mason, Warren and the detective confront Hank, but he has an alibi for summer's murder. Joe wants Kelly to quit her waitressing job, but she refuses. Cruz tells Eden he might want to go back to being a cop.

Gina and CC have sex. Joe goes out of town, but he asks CC to get the police to watch her. Peter sets it up so Kelly comes to a warehouse, but she sends Eden instead. Kelly comforts Sophia at the hospital. Cruz realizes that Warren wasn't the person who killed Amado and attacked Mason. C.C. tries to show empathy for what happened to Mason so he could win back Sophia. Suzanne wants to leave town. Kelly tries to convince Sophia to move back home.
Cruz gives Warren the ballistic report that doesn't help him at all. Lionel and Sophia discuss about their children. **Last appearance of Carrington Garland (Kelly Capwell)

Cassandra spends time by Mason's side in the hospital, and she thinks of the potential murder suspects. Angela gives Dash a gardening job. Angela and Warren discuss his alibi. David tells Angela that she hired a rapist. Gina snoops for the Marilyn Cassidy file. Gina tries to convince Katrina that Dash has not changed. Angela goes to Cruz about the attempt made on Mason's life.

Cruz and Michael search for Warren. Angela gives Warren the alibi, claiming that he spent the time with her when the attack happened. Cassandra finds a photo in Warren's jacket and immediately thinks that he was the one who attacked Mason.

Warren thanks Angela for her help. Dash surprises them. Gina doesn't hide her disgust over Santana and Rosa. Santana makes a few changes at the Capwell mansion, and Rosa is confused by it. Dash catches Angela and Warren together. Santana and Rosa argue about Santana wanting to move into the Capwell mansion. Angela warns Dash to keep his mouth shut about what he has witnessed.

CC calls Katrina, Eden. The new district attorney blames Warren for the attack, and he decides to have him arrested. Warren asks for Julia's help. Katrina moves out of the Capwell mansion. C.C., Gina and Rosa try to convince her to stay. Katrina and Suzanne decide to become roommates. Gina tells CC that Santana is the one who told Katrina she should move out.

Michael arrests Warren. Lionel wants to hire a lawyer, but Warren rejects his help. Lionel asks for Cassie's help, but she doesn't take his offer, so Angela ends up paying for Warren. Craig tells CC that Katrina was roughed up because of Dash. Cassie and Lionel are confused at who paid Warren's bail. CC tells Katrina he only wishes the best for her.

David tells Julia that he loves her, but she says that she still isn't over Mason. Mason exits the hospital and acquires a gun from Craig. He visits Angela and Warren and causes a hug terror when he takes out the gun. Julia continues to beg off David's advances. Cassie tells Cruz that Mason has a gun.

Mason is shocked when he shoots Warren. Angela goes to find Dash to treat Warren. Warren hides at Suzanne's place while Cruz looks for him. Craig wants Dash to leave the town and forget about Katrina. Mason blackmails Angela. Angela doesn't believe Warren. Dash tells Angela if she speaks well of him to Katrina, Dash will forget about Angela and Warren.

Katrina, now living at Suzanne's, receives a request from Warren to find his friend in Russia. David wants to divorce Angela as soon as possible. He continues pressing Julia about his feeling, but she doesn't respond well to his requests. An anonymous person makes prank call to Mason.

Sophia tells Lionel that her departure might be the best thing for their kids. Michael gives Katrina a message which she is supposed to give to Warren, who is in hiding. Cruz gets a lead that Eden has been spotted in Mexico but he is not sure if he should check it. Suzanne puts him back to form by persuading him he should leave immediately and give it a try. Cruz thanks her and tells her that he is proud of her that she's made a new beginning in her life. Cassandra confronts Mason about his shooting Warren but they soon get back together.

Angela talks to David and begs him not to go through with the divorce. Gina has planned a surprise for C.C but Santana comes and he prefers to talk with her. Craig sees the whole scene and tells Gina that he will help her. Angela tries to find where Warren is again but Suzanne and Lionel refuse to tell her. Santana talks to Cruz as she has found new feelings towards C.C but Suzanne comes and Santana leaves.

C.C. thanks Gina for last night and tells her that he finds her almost bearable. Gina is flattered and hopeful. Meanwhile, Santana asks Rosa for some room in the kitchen because she wants to cook dinner for C.C. Rosa tells her that she should keep her distance, as C.C. is still in love with Sophia but Santana tells her that she just wants to thank him for helping her launch her new business.

CC tells Craig he believes that Gina and Santana are competing for his attention. Minx goes to meet Katrina, since Amado was so find of her. Craig and Santana butt heads about the way Santana is spending CC's money for redecorating.

Santana talks to Rosa and persuades her to go out with Rafael one more time. Later, she watches Warren's broadcast on TV and feels very proud of her old friend. Craig throws to her some very bad remarks about him but Santana gives her full support. Gina and C.C watch too and while C.C is busy Gina gets a note that Mason has sent to Cassandra asking her to marry him while Warren is gone.

Sophia is livid when she finds CC and Santana finally getting rid of Channing's things. Julia returns to Santa Barbara after her trip. She meets with David and they talk about what's been going on between them. David tells her that he doesn't blame her or anyone else for his problems with Angela and apologizes about his bad behavior. Cassandra is watching Warren on the T.V and feels very touched.

Everybody is watching Warren in Moscow. Katrina is touched by a girl's story while Mason and Gina talk about Warren. He tells her that he rearranged a wedding date and Gina suspects that there is a connection between Warren's absence and Mason's wedding plans. Cassandra visits Minx at her suite and they have a talk with Lionel.

David tells Julia that Angela has been blackmailing him into staying married. Gina asks CC to go with her to Lamaze classes, butt CC says no. Craig comforts Gina and they kiss. Julia does some investigating on Angela's sister Marilyn's death. Gina and Cassie fight so Gina blabs to the society page about Cassie and Mason being married in San Francisco. Ted is being followed in Chinatown.

Katrina and Suzanne plan a surprise party for Cruz's birthday while Sophia gives him a present. Cruz finds a note with a riddle that leads him to the Oasis.

Katrina talks to Suzanne who is totally freaked out. Suzanne feels guilty because of her feelings for Cruz. Chip is upset because he thinks that the misunderstanding with Suzanne was his fault and Cruz tells him it's not.

Cassandra and Mason are still in the park and Mason can't understand how in the world a portrait of Ted could be there. Julia calls David and tells him her feelings as the wedding comes closer and Angela walks in. She is being sarcastic about David's affair with Julia. Warren calls Lionel from Alaska and tells him that he'll be back today.

Warren and Angela are half-naked in the office and they talk about their no commitment deal. Cassandra and Mason call Suzanne and ask her if by any chance she has painted a portrait of Ted. After she tells them she hasn't, Mason is sure that Eden is the one who's painted it.

Mason, Cassandra and Julia return to the hotel but Mason leaves to show the seller of the portrait a photo of Eden. Angela and David talk and she wonders why he continues to support her even though he knows the truth. David suggests that she admits the truth in public. Santana tells Rosa that CC needs to move on. Mason calls CC to tell him that Ted is in Chinatown.

Mason and Cassandra wake up together and start to make love. Mason can't do it so Cassandra tells him it's because of Julia's being in the next room. Ted packs his things as he feels he is in danger and tells his friends that he can't keep on risking their daughter's life. David comes to San Francisco and asks Julia if her trip to Boston had anything to do with the investigation of Marilyn.

Mason questions Julia about David's sudden departure. He confesses to her that jealousy wells up in him every time he sees her with another man. Mason hypothesizes that their apparent feelings towards each other is the real reason David decided not to stay in San Francisco. Mason then asks Julia to at least admit that they still love each other.

Mason has spotted the building in the portrait and has rushed inside with Julia and Cassie following closely behind. At the Oasis, Lionel meets up with Jim Sanford, Warren's attorney, to discuss his progress on the case. Lionel notices Angela and tries to reinforce his theory that makes Angela the prime suspect who shot Mason. Craig delivers a letter to C.C.

Sophia and Kelly go over to show concern for Gina. When Kelly suggests the hospital, Gina panics and says that the pains have subsided. Kelly lectures Gina on how she should not take anything too lightly. Gina stands up and says that it was probably something she ate. She asks Craig to call C.C to come pick her up, but Craig insists that he'd be the one to take her home.

Cassie wakes up and tells Mason that she has an uneasy feeling that something terrible will happen to ruin their wedding. Mason calms her down and talks about their plans for the wedding. Warren tells Angela that he is in a perfect relationship with her, no strings attached. Angela embraces him, but her face shows signs of disappointment. C.C. and Santana exchange good morning kisses.

Angela finds Lionel at the Oasis and blames him that Warren's lawyer is following her. Lionel admits it is him that follows her because he believes she shot Mason and killed Amado. Julia is looking at herself at the mirror fantasizing she is the one getting married to Mason. Rosa is thrilled to welcome Ted home. Mason rushes into her room looking for Cassandra.

Warren waits hidden for the wedding to start. When it starts, he runs to the altar and kidnaps Cassandra! At the Capwell mansion, C.C and Santana finally see Ted. Everybody is happy except Craig. C.C asks Craig to help him make Ted stay in Santa Barbara for good by matching him up with Katrina. Ted gives presents to everyone. C.C introduces him to Katrina and they immediately get along.

Sophia sees Ted for the first time and she frowns as she misses Eden and Mason. Kelly comes and tells everybody about Warren trying again to stop the wedding. C.C is angry with Katrina for not saying anything and questions her loyalty in the family. Warren and Cassandra get in a cell in Alcatraz and a furious Cassandra climbs at the top to scream for help.

Angela is persuaded that the woman in Warren's life is Santana and she tells Lionel. Gina calls Lily and invites her to Santa Barbara. Lily while gambling in a casino tells her that she'll be too busy. Santana makes C.C go to the hospital to have his wounds examined.

Everyone in the house blames Dash for C.C.'s attack. Santana wakes C.C. up and they start to make out. She accidentally drops her hair-bow in his bed. Katrina and Kelly fight as Kelly blames Dash and Ted watches the whole scene. Kelly talks to Mason on the phone and goes on to blame Warren too. Katrina stands up for Warren too.

Dash visits C.C. to examine him and Craig throws him out. C.C. tells Craig he should have been more gentle. Still, he is worried about Katrina and is angry with Dash about the attack. Angela goes to the paper's office and bumps into Lionel. They have another fight. Mason locks Warren inside the cell and takes Cassie with him.

Cassandra returns to the hotel room and tells everyone what has happened. Craig finds Dash and tells him that Katrina's visa expires in a few days and if he wants her to stay in the U.S he must break up with her immediately and leave town. Julia and David leave with a helicopter for Alcatraz. Warren calls Mason who is in a balcony. Mason trips, falls and loses his gun. Warren returns to San Francisco and after settling things straight with Kelly, who is frightened of him at first, he starts to talk with Cassie. Julia puts herself on trial as she desperately tries to sort out her feelings for Mason.

Lily meets Ted for the first time since her return. They catch up on old times. Ted and Kelly worry that Mason is a ticking bomb ready to go off at Warren. Warren and Angela try to decipher the real assailant through the photos of the party.

Warren dictates an editorial about the whole Capwell-Lockridge feud and how the torch has been passed down from father to son. David tells Angela that the kidnapping charges against Warren have been dropped. He warns her not to get to involved because Warren might implicate her to save himself. Craig talks to Katrina and tells her that he will help her out if she has any problems with her visa. Warren worries for his life as he feels the noose around his neck tightening. Cassie is upset with Mason for seeking the death penalty.

Gina tries her best to get back into C.C.'s good graces, but he will not give her the time of day. She proposes that she and Craig pair up to serve their own best interests. C.C.

C.C. and Santana begin to rekindle their relationship. He gives her a beautiful pearl necklace and suggests that they take a romantic stroll on the beach. Ted stops by the newspaper and offers to help edit Katrina's article. Angela is rummaging through Craig's stuff unaware that she is being observed by Dash. Craig decides to bring Angela home.

Gina goes over to Craig's to thank him for his help with C.C. She finds Angela there and gets jealous. Santana informs C.C. that it is her birthday. He insists that they go out to celebrate after the trial. Lily and Ted bond as she helps him decorate the Capwell Christmas tree. Katrina sees Mason drowning his sorrows in alcohol and goes over to talk to him. He shares all his sorrows with her. They then play a cat and mouse game in trying to determine who is the culprit.

C.C. and Santana wake up in each other's arms. They talk about their inner child and how it must be set free once in a while. Angela is writing letters to Warren. News of David and Angela's divorce hits the papers.

Warren asks to speak to Julia in private.

Angela is called to the stand but David manages to ask for a recess. Warren remains adamant that Angela should not testify. C.C stops by Craig's house and finds Gina there. Angela is certain that Craig is the killer. She tries to get away from him by making up all sorts of excuses, but he sticks to her like glue. He says that he needs to have a little talk with her. Angela manages to retreat to the courthouse where she scribbles "Craig has the bullets" on a piece of Kleenex. She slips the note into Cruz's pocket just before Craig drags her out the courthouse.

Warren calls everyone down to witness his last editorial before the verdict. He informs them that Angela's testimony was an act and that she was on their side all the time. Gina and Lily are driving home when she hears that the verdict will be out soon. She forces Lily to drive to Angela's house so that she can gloat. Craig has Angela at gunpoint.

The morning newspapers highlight the arrest of Craig Hunt for the shooting. Brandon tries to prevent Gina from seeing it. He tries to persuade his mother to call C.C., but Gina remains adamant about keeping the birth a secret. Santana thanks C.C. for giving her the best Christmas she has had in years. Ted comes in and interrupts them. He tells his father that he found out that it was C.C.

Lily brings Ted to the vet's office but finds that Gina is not there. Lily is worried about her mother's erratic behavior lately. C.C. receives the final divorce papers from Sophia's lawyer. Gina, with baby in tow, barges into Lionel's office claiming to be his new secretary. Minx is baffled as she watches Gina redecorate Lionel's office. C.C. lays into Cruz over his relationship with Suzanne.

A reporter is interviewing Julia on her victory. Mason sees her and barges in. He has a long conversation with Julia over the trial and how it has changed him for the better. He says that he is happy that C.C.'s bad judge of character is finally out in the open. He asks Julia to start a new beginning with him.

It's New Year's Eve, Kelly visits Sophia. She tells Kelly that it is becoming easier for her to get through the lonely nights without her family. David drops by to hand her the first settlement payment. Suzanne is nervous about her date with Cruz because she knows that it will mark the beginning of a whole new relationship between them.

Lily walks in on Ted taking down the Christmas tree and offers her help. Gina, with baby Capwell, enters Lionel's office and sets off the alarm. Lionel, awakened by the alarm, grabs a golf club and heads inside to protect his property. He finds Gina cowering behind a screen. Lionel tells her that she needs to see a doctor because she is not acting rationally.

Suzanne is in a rotten mood in the morning. She confides in Katrina that she can't help but feel Eden's presence whenever she is with Cruz. Mason asks Cassie if she had contacted Warren after the trial. She snaps at him to stop throwing Warren's at her every time they have a conversation. Angela buys Warren's rival newspaper, The Santa Barbara Bulletin for him as a victory present.

Santana is showing her designs to Kelly for approval. Kelly tells Santana that she really does not care about the decorations and tells her to take it up with C.C. Cruz track Suzanne down to the Oasis. He asks her what the problem was but she says nothing. Kelly invites David to dinner to discuss business. Sophia sees Cruz and Suzanne talking affectionately and feels uncomfortable.

David tells Kelly to stay out of his personal life. He tells her that he let Angela control all aspects of his life and does not intend to make the same mistake again. Cassie is drunk. She tells Mason that she wants to tell Warren the news herself. She adds that she will have to tell Julia what an evil and manipulative man he has been in hopes that Julia will leave him.

Cassie agonizes over how she will break the news to Warren. Ted and Kelly join Sophia for breakfast. Kelly tells Ted about the embarrassing run in she had with David the night before. Mason shows up at Julia's to take her out for breakfast. Katrina questions Suzanne about her night with Cruz, but she evades the question and buries herself in work. Mason and Julia arrive at the Oasis.

C.C. invites Santana to a prestigious club for dinner, much to Rosa's strong objections. Lily tracks Lionel down to the club and asks him to talk Gina into taking her medication. Gina arrives shortly and invites them to Channing's christening. Both Lily and Lionel say that they will not accept unless she invites C.C. Rosa expresses her concern over C.C.'s invitation.

Cassie goes to Warren's office under the pretense of looking for Lionel. Warren is very formal towards her. She asks if there was any tension between him and Lionel, and when she receives a negative answer, she realizes that her message was not as effective as she had hoped. C.C. makes a huge scene at the club regarding their treatment of Santana. He storms out, vowing to close the club down.

A black tie benefit is being thrown in Cruz's honor at the Oasis and Suzanne is all upset because she has to cover the event and interview Cruz. Katrina offers to trade places, but Suzanne declines siting that it would compromise her professionalism. Rafael asks Cruz about his problem with Suzanne. He tells his son not to give up on her so easily.

Gina, her normal self again, shows Channing off to Sophia at the benefit. At her table, Sophia receives a bottle of champagne and a gift from an anonymous person. Warren ponders over the birth certificate. He tells Angela that he wants to go to the party to find Lionel. Ted asks Lily why she is staying in town. He also asks her to tell him the truth about Frankie.

Mason's guilt over hurting Cassie manifests itself as nightmares. In it, Cassie's proclamations of gloom and doom over his relationship with Julia hit just the right mark. Kelly, Ted and Cruz unwind after the party. Cassie comes over, drunk, and oozes venom about Mason to them. Lily is at Dash's office, severely beat up.

Lionel tells Gina to keep her duties strictly professional, but stubborn old Gina goes through his personal mail and is intrigued by the contents within. Rafael tries to convince Suzanne to give Cruz another chance. He tells her that no matter what she does to change her physical appearance, it will not change her heart. Suzanne gets irritated with Rafael and they end off on an unpleasant note.

Craig has commandeered the transport and its passengers. He ties the guards up and leaves them in the middle of nowhere as he heads back to Santa Barbara. Gina catches Lily eavesdropping on Ted's conversation with Dash. She confronts Lily about it and Lily tells her to stay out of her personal life. Cassie is anxiously awaiting Warren's arrival.

Craig is forced to kidnap Kelly after realizing that there's nothing else he can do. Sophia, Mason and Cruz are worried about Kelly. Warren is shocked to find out that Lionel isn't his biological father. He is crushed by the fact that Lionel never said anything, and he questions him about who is his father, but Lionel doesn't know because Augusta never told him.

C.C. is shocked to learn that Craig took Kelly as a hostage. Mason blames C.C. for the entire situation because C.C. always encouraged Craig. Rosa is skeptical over Santana. Rafael tells C.C. that he expects him to marry Santana.

Kelly manages to free herself from Craig and rushes to Gina. Craig is starting to lose his mind by threatening both women. Lily isn't satisfied with her life with Ted. Angela questions Warren about his feelings for Cassandra.

Cruz finally finds Craig and then offers to become his hostage in exchange for Kelly and Gina's security. Hunt accepts the offer, but refuses to let Kelly go. Mason and Julia question their love life, but Julia remains trying not to get too much involved.

Katrina and Dash's relationship goes forward when Katrina manages to publish an article on Dash and numerous companies offer to give him a job. Dash realizes that the jobs are far away from Santa Barbara, but to please Katrina, he doesn't say anything to her. Craig bounds Cruz and Kelly. C.C. is ready to pay the ransom. With Mason's help, C.C. manages to find Craig and put his plan in motion.

Cruz manages to free the hostages and then goes on a hunt after Craig. They start shooting, and Craig provokes Cruz by mentioning Eden. Cruz accidentally fires a shot at the pilot of the plane. Cassandra appears suddenly and manages to convince Craig to surrender. Katrina learns about Dash's job offer and then she persuades him to take it.

Mason tries to persuade Julia to marry him, and although she expresses her love for him, she doesn't want to get married.
